source: Media Intelligence Skill Catalog (provided planning catalog, 250 proposed skills across 25 categories)
note: Catalog entries are capability definitions, not vendor implementations. They seed plans generated by this Skill Tool.

skills.name: Universal Media Intake
skills.description: Accept, identify, and route mixed image, video, audio, music, document, subtitle, stream, archive, and sensor files while preserving source order and relationships.

skills.name: Media Type and Codec Detector
skills.description: Determine container, codec, encoding, bit depth, channel layout, frame rate, color space, resolution, duration, and likely decoder requirements before processing.

skills.name: Corrupt Media Triage
skills.description: Detect truncation, damaged headers, missing indexes, broken frames, silent channels, malformed metadata, and partial uploads, then recommend safe repair or recovery paths.

skills.name: Archive and Package Explorer
skills.description: Inspect ZIP, TAR, project bundles, camera cards, and editing packages; inventory nested assets and map dependency links without losing directory context.

skills.name: Batch Media Organizer
skills.description: Group large media collections by source, date, subject, event, format, similarity, and processing priority, with duplicate-aware naming and manifests.

skills.name: Streaming Source Intake
skills.description: Connect to live or recorded streams, segment them safely, monitor continuity, and create checkpoints for later analysis.

skills.name: Camera Roll Curator
skills.description: Scan personal or project camera rolls, cluster bursts and events, flag poor captures, and surface representative images while keeping originals untouched.

skills.name: Cross-File Relationship Mapper
skills.description: Link thumbnails, proxies, originals, sidecar files, captions, stems, transcripts, and project files into a coherent asset graph.

skills.name: Media Normalization Planner
skills.description: Plan non-destructive conversions into analysis-ready formats while retaining originals, technical metadata, timing, and provenance.

skills.name: Input Safety Scanner
skills.description: Screen media for decompression bombs, malformed payloads, suspicious macros, hidden executables, and other unsafe ingestion conditions before deeper processing.

skills.name: Image Scene Interpreter
skills.description: Describe the setting, subjects, actions, relationships, lighting, composition, and likely context of an image, separating visible evidence from inference.

skills.name: Object and Attribute Detector
skills.description: Locate objects and report attributes such as color, material, condition, orientation, count, and spatial relation with confidence-aware wording.

skills.name: Fine-Grained Visual Classifier
skills.description: Distinguish closely related visual categories using domain references, uncertainty thresholds, and escalation when evidence is insufficient.

skills.name: Image Region Grounder
skills.description: Connect claims to precise regions, bounding boxes, masks, or coordinates so findings can be inspected and reused downstream.

skills.name: Visual Counting and Density Estimator
skills.description: Count distinct items when feasible and estimate dense crowds or repeated objects with ranges, assumptions, and occlusion notes.

skills.name: Indoor Space Interpreter
skills.description: Understand rooms, fixtures, pathways, furniture, hazards, signage, and functional zones for navigation, inventory, or inspection workflows.

skills.name: Outdoor Environment Interpreter
skills.description: Analyze terrain, roads, vegetation, weather cues, structures, traffic context, and observable environmental conditions.

skills.name: Product Image Analyzer
skills.description: Identify product type, visible features, packaging, condition, variants, accessories, and listing-relevant details without inventing hidden specifications.

skills.name: Food and Ingredient Visual Analyzer
skills.description: Recognize visible dishes and ingredients, estimate portions cautiously, and flag uncertainty, allergens, or non-visible preparation details.

skills.name: Artwork and Design Interpreter
skills.description: Analyze style, medium, composition, motifs, typography, palette, technique, and design intent while avoiding unsupported attribution.

skills.name: Long-Form Video Interpreter
skills.description: Watch video across its full timeline, track topics and events, and produce chaptered understanding rather than relying only on sampled frames.

skills.name: Shot and Scene Boundary Detector
skills.description: Detect cuts, dissolves, fades, angle changes, and scene transitions; output timecoded segments suitable for editing and review.

skills.name: Action and Activity Recognizer
skills.description: Identify observable actions over time, distinguish ongoing from completed events, and report uncertainty for ambiguous motion.

skills.name: Multi-Object Tracker
skills.description: Track people and objects across frames, occlusions, re-entry, and camera movement while maintaining stable identities where evidence supports it.

skills.name: Event Timeline Builder
skills.description: Create a chronological, timecoded account of key events, participants, causes, outcomes, and unresolved moments in a video.

skills.name: Video Chapter Generator
skills.description: Generate useful chapter titles, summaries, keyframes, and navigation markers based on content shifts and viewer goals.

skills.name: Highlight and Best-Moment Finder
skills.description: Select compelling, informative, emotional, or action-heavy moments using configurable criteria, duration targets, and repetition controls.

skills.name: Instructional Video Step Extractor
skills.description: Turn demonstrations into ordered steps with tools, prerequisites, actions, checkpoints, warnings, and time references.

skills.name: Sports and Performance Analyzer
skills.description: Track plays, movements, technique, timing, formations, repetitions, and performance cues from available footage with sport-specific context.

skills.name: Screen Recording Interpreter
skills.description: Understand interface actions, cursor movement, typed input, errors, menus, and workflow sequence from software demonstrations or support recordings.

skills.name: Robust Speech Transcriber
skills.description: Transcribe speech with timestamps, punctuation, speaker turns, confidence markers, and configurable verbatim or clean-read output.

skills.name: Speaker Diarization
skills.description: Separate and label speakers across overlaps, interruptions, re-entry, and background speech while avoiding identity claims without evidence.

skills.name: Sound Event Detector
skills.description: Recognize non-speech events such as alarms, impacts, engines, doors, animals, applause, water, tools, and ambient activity with timestamps.

skills.name: Acoustic Scene Classifier
skills.description: Infer broad sound environments such as office, street, vehicle, classroom, concert, or nature from layered acoustic evidence.

skills.name: Voice Quality Analyzer
skills.description: Assess intelligibility, loudness, clipping, noise, reverberation, pacing, pauses, and vocal consistency for production or accessibility.

skills.name: Meeting Audio Interpreter
skills.description: Extract agenda changes, decisions, action items, objections, commitments, and unresolved questions from multi-speaker recordings.

skills.name: Call Center Conversation Analyzer
skills.description: Identify intent, issue type, resolution path, escalation, hold periods, compliance phrases, and customer experience signals.

skills.name: Emergency Sound Alert Interpreter
skills.description: Detect and prioritize urgent audible cues such as smoke alarms, distress calls, crashes, or breaking glass, with conservative confidence handling.

skills.name: Animal and Nature Sound Interpreter
skills.description: Classify observable biological and environmental sounds where references support it, and distinguish likely calls from noise or mimicry.

skills.name: Audio Segment and Silence Mapper
skills.description: Map speech, music, ambience, silence, crosstalk, and noise regions to support editing, transcription, and quality review.

skills.name: Music Structure Analyzer
skills.description: Map intro, verse, chorus, bridge, solo, breakdown, outro, transitions, repetitions, and time positions across a track.

skills.name: Tempo Beat and Meter Detector
skills.description: Estimate tempo, downbeats, beat grid, meter, rubato, and tempo changes, exposing uncertainty when rhythm is irregular.

skills.name: Key Chord and Harmony Analyzer
skills.description: Estimate tonal center, chord progression, modulation, cadence, and harmonic rhythm with confidence-aware alternatives.

skills.name: Melody and Motif Tracker
skills.description: Identify recurring melodic shapes, hooks, motifs, variations, and call-and-response relationships across voices or instruments.

skills.name: Instrument and Ensemble Recognizer
skills.description: Identify likely instruments, families, roles, entrances, and texture while accounting for synthesis and production effects.

skills.name: Vocal Performance Interpreter
skills.description: Analyze phrasing, register, articulation, harmonies, breath, timbre, dynamics, and performance consistency without medical diagnosis.

skills.name: Music Mood and Energy Mapper
skills.description: Describe changing energy, tension, valence, density, and cinematic function over time using transparent musical cues.

skills.name: Stem and Mix Relationship Analyzer
skills.description: Compare vocals, drums, bass, instruments, and effects for balance, masking, width, dynamics, and arrangement interaction.

skills.name: Music Similarity and Reference Matcher
skills.description: Compare tracks by structure, rhythm, harmony, instrumentation, production, and mood while separating influence from copying claims.

skills.name: Practice and Rehearsal Coach
skills.description: Review a recorded performance for timing, tuning, consistency, articulation, ensemble alignment, and section-specific practice priorities.

skills.name: Scene Text OCR
skills.description: Extract print, handwriting, labels, signs, screens, and curved or perspective-distorted text while retaining location and confidence.

skills.name: Subtitle and Caption Extractor
skills.description: Read embedded, burned-in, or sidecar captions; preserve timing, speaker labels, sound cues, styling, and language information.

skills.name: Caption Alignment Repair
skills.description: Detect early, late, drifting, duplicated, missing, or overlapping captions and propose corrected timing without changing intended wording unnecessarily.

skills.name: On-Screen Graphics Interpreter
skills.description: Understand lower thirds, tickers, scoreboards, diagrams, callouts, titles, and overlays in relation to the surrounding scene.

skills.name: Handwriting and Whiteboard Reader
skills.description: Recover legible text, arrows, groupings, equations, and diagram relationships from notes, boards, or photographed pages.

skills.name: Visual Form and Receipt Extractor
skills.description: Extract fields, totals, dates, line items, checkboxes, tables, and signatures from photographed or scanned transactional documents.

skills.name: Multilingual Visual Text Reader
skills.description: Detect language and script, transcribe visible text, preserve original spelling, and offer translations with uncertainty markers.

skills.name: Text-in-Video Change Tracker
skills.description: Track appearing, changing, scrolling, or disappearing text over time, including counters, labels, prompts, and alerts.

skills.name: Equation and Notation Reader
skills.description: Interpret mathematical notation, chemical expressions, music notation, and technical symbols with structure-aware output.

skills.name: Signage and Wayfinding Interpreter
skills.description: Read directional, regulatory, warning, transit, and facility signs and connect them to visible spatial context.

skills.name: Observable Affect Describer
skills.description: Describe visible and audible cues such as smiling, hesitation, raised volume, or posture while avoiding unsupported claims about hidden feelings.

skills.name: Conversation Dynamics Analyzer
skills.description: Map turn-taking, interruptions, pauses, dominance, agreement, repair, and participation balance in group interactions.

skills.name: Engagement Signal Analyzer
skills.description: Identify observable attention and participation cues across meetings, lessons, presentations, or interviews with context and privacy safeguards.

skills.name: Presentation Delivery Reviewer
skills.description: Assess pacing, clarity, filler words, vocal variety, framing, gestures, slide coordination, and audience-facing delivery.

skills.name: Interview Response Analyzer
skills.description: Structure answers, evidence, uncertainty, follow-up needs, and communication patterns without making protected-trait or employment decisions.

skills.name: Conflict and De-escalation Cue Analyzer
skills.description: Identify escalating language, overlap, volume shifts, withdrawal, and repair attempts, then summarize interaction patterns neutrally.

skills.name: Customer Demonstration Reaction Mapper
skills.description: Link observable reactions and comments to product moments, misunderstandings, delight, friction, and unanswered needs.

skills.name: Learning Participation Analyzer
skills.description: Track questions, responses, demonstrations, confusion cues, and participation opportunities without ranking learners by sensitive traits.

skills.name: Human-Object Interaction Interpreter
skills.description: Describe how people manipulate tools, controls, products, sports equipment, or household objects over time.

skills.name: Group Activity Role Mapper
skills.description: Identify functional roles visible in collaborative activity, such as presenter, operator, responder, or observer, without guessing identity or status.

skills.name: Camera Motion Estimator
skills.description: Detect pans, tilts, zooms, rolls, handheld shake, tracking moves, and static shots for stabilization and editorial analysis.

skills.name: Human Pose and Movement Analyzer
skills.description: Track body landmarks and movement phases for form review, animation reference, ergonomics, or sports analysis.

skills.name: Gesture and Sign Sequence Interpreter
skills.description: Recognize gesture sequences where supported, preserve temporal order, and route formal sign-language translation to qualified models or reviewers.

skills.name: Trajectory and Path Analyzer
skills.description: Map motion paths, direction changes, speed trends, stops, crossings, and near interactions in image or video coordinates.

skills.name: Depth and Occlusion Reasoner
skills.description: Infer front-to-back relationships, partial visibility, occlusion, and approximate depth while clearly labeling monocular uncertainty.

skills.name: Room Layout Reconstructor
skills.description: Estimate spatial arrangement, openings, surfaces, furniture placement, and walkable zones from one or more views.

skills.name: Measurement from Reference
skills.description: Estimate dimensions only when a reliable scale reference, camera geometry, or calibration is available, and report tolerance ranges.

skills.name: Motion Anomaly Detector
skills.description: Flag unusual movement patterns relative to a defined baseline, camera behavior, and scene context without treating rarity as wrongdoing.

skills.name: Ergonomic Motion Reviewer
skills.description: Identify visible posture, repetition, reach, lift, and workstation patterns to support screening, not clinical or regulatory conclusions.

skills.name: Robotic Perception Interface
skills.description: Convert detected objects, poses, masks, depth cues, and trajectories into structured observations for downstream robotic planning with safety gates.

skills.name: Image Quality Assessor
skills.description: Measure and explain blur, noise, compression, exposure, contrast, color cast, banding, artifacts, and resolution limits.

skills.name: Video Quality Assessor
skills.description: Detect dropped or duplicate frames, judder, stutter, tearing, macroblocking, flicker, focus drift, and cadence issues over time.

skills.name: Audio Quality Assessor
skills.description: Measure clipping, hum, hiss, plosives, sibilance, room echo, dropouts, loudness inconsistency, and channel faults.

skills.name: Lip-Sync and AV Alignment Checker
skills.description: Measure whether speech, mouth motion, effects, music, and picture events are synchronized and locate offset or drift.

skills.name: Color Pipeline Inspector
skills.description: Inspect transfer characteristics, gamut, white balance, legal range, HDR metadata, clipping, and conversion risks.

skills.name: Compression Artifact Diagnoser
skills.description: Differentiate source defects from codec artifacts and recommend bitrate, codec, filtering, or re-export changes.

skills.name: Camera and Lens Issue Detector
skills.description: Flag focus errors, dirty lens or sensor spots, rolling shutter, distortion, stabilization problems, flare, and chromatic aberration.

skills.name: Microphone and Channel Fault Detector
skills.description: Identify dead channels, phase issues, polarity problems, channel swaps, imbalance, interference, and intermittent connectors.

skills.name: Media Conformance Validator
skills.description: Check files against delivery specifications for duration, format, codec, loudness, captions, frame rate, naming, and metadata.

skills.name: Reference-to-Export Comparator
skills.description: Compare source and export for missing content, color shifts, timing changes, audio differences, text errors, and unwanted crops.

skills.name: Accessible Caption Author
skills.description: Create readable timed captions with speaker identification, meaningful sound cues, line- length control, and synchronization.

skills.name: Audio Description Author
skills.description: Write concise descriptions of essential visual information that fit natural pauses without duplicating dialogue.

skills.name: Descriptive Transcript Builder
skills.description: Combine dialogue, speakers, sound events, music cues, and visual descriptions into a navigable text alternative.

skills.name: Caption Readability Auditor
skills.description: Check speed, duration, line breaks, overlap, contrast, placement, and obstruction of important visual content.

skills.name: Color and Contrast Accessibility Auditor
skills.description: Evaluate text, controls, charts, and overlays for contrast and color-dependence, including common color-vision deficiencies.

skills.name: Flashing and Motion Risk Auditor
skills.description: Detect rapid flashes, strobing, intense patterns, and motion sequences that may require warning or remediation.

skills.name: Sign-Language Video Quality Reviewer
skills.description: Check signer visibility, framing, lighting, occlusion, timing, inset size, and continuity without claiming translation accuracy beyond evidence.

skills.name: Plain-Language Media Summarizer
skills.description: Convert complex audiovisual content into clear, structured summaries while retaining critical meaning and terminology.

skills.name: Accessible Player Metadata Builder
skills.description: Generate chapter labels, language tags, caption tracks, descriptive audio labels, thumbnails, and navigation metadata.

skills.name: Inclusive Media Remediation Planner
skills.description: Prioritize accessibility defects, propose fixes, identify human-review needs, and document unresolved limitations.

skills.name: Smart Video Trimmer
skills.description: Remove dead space, false starts, long pauses, and irrelevant sections according to explicit editorial goals while preserving narrative continuity.

skills.name: Content-Aware Reframing
skills.description: Recompose horizontal, vertical, and square versions while tracking important subjects, text, gestures, and safe areas.

skills.name: Object Removal Planner
skills.description: Identify removable visual elements, required masks, motion complexity, occlusion challenges, and quality risks before inpainting.

skills.name: Background Replacement Coordinator
skills.description: Separate foreground, hair, transparent edges, shadows, and motion blur to guide realistic or stylized background replacement.

skills.name: Image Restoration Specialist
skills.description: Plan denoising, deblurring, scratch repair, color recovery, upscaling, and face-detail restraint for old or damaged images.

skills.name: Audio Cleanup and Enhancement Planner
skills.description: Select noise reduction, de-reverberation, EQ, de-click, de-hum, repair, and loudness steps with artifact checks.

skills.name: Dialogue and Music Balance Assistant
skills.description: Automate ducking, level rides, sidechain suggestions, and intelligibility checks while preserving musical intent.

skills.name: Multi-Camera Edit Assistant
skills.description: Synchronize angles, identify active speakers or actions, recommend cuts, and preserve continuity across cameras and audio sources.

skills.name: Continuity Error Finder
skills.description: Detect mismatched props, wardrobe, screen direction, lighting, positions, dialogue, or timing across edits and takes.

skills.name: Versioned Media Transformation
skills.description: Apply repeatable edits through non-destructive recipes, preserve originals, record parameters, and support rollback and comparison.

skills.name: Semantic Media Search
skills.description: Retrieve moments using natural-language descriptions of people, objects, actions, dialogue, sounds, music, text, mood, or setting.

skills.name: Timecoded Evidence Retriever
skills.description: Return exact timestamps, frames, transcript spans, and supporting observations for each answer about a media collection.

skills.name: Visual Similarity Search
skills.description: Find exact or near-duplicate images, frames, logos, products, scenes, or compositions with configurable similarity thresholds.

skills.name: Audio Similarity Search
skills.description: Find matching or related sound events, voices where consent permits, musical passages, jingles, or acoustic environments.

skills.name: Cross-Modal Search
skills.description: Use text to find images, audio to find video moments, an image to find related clips, or a clip to locate transcript references.

skills.name: Face-Optional Identity-Agnostic Search
skills.description: Find the same visible person across approved media using clothing, location, timing, and track continuity without naming them.

skills.name: Metadata and Content Fusion Search
skills.description: Combine file metadata, transcripts, embeddings, tags, project context, and human annotations into ranked retrieval.

skills.name: Media Question Answering
skills.description: Answer questions over one or many media files with citations to timestamps, regions, speakers, and source files.

skills.name: Event-Based Archive Navigator
skills.description: Organize and retrieve media by real-world events, sessions, locations, participants, and chronology using evidence-linked clusters.

skills.name: Search Quality Evaluator
skills.description: Test retrieval with relevance sets, false-positive analysis, coverage measures, hard negatives, and user-oriented success criteria.

skills.name: Multimodal Executive Summarizer
skills.description: Produce concise summaries that combine spoken content, visuals, text, sounds, and temporal context without over-weighting transcripts.

skills.name: Detailed Media Analyst Report
skills.description: Create structured findings with scope, sources, timeline, observations, interpretations, uncertainty, and recommended next steps.

skills.name: Keyframe Storyboard Generator
skills.description: Select representative frames and pair them with timecodes and captions to communicate the full narrative efficiently.

skills.name: Decision and Action Extractor
skills.description: Identify explicit decisions, owners, deadlines, dependencies, and open questions from audiovisual meetings or reviews.

skills.name: Evidence Table Builder
skills.description: Convert observations into a traceable table of claim, source file, timestamp or region, confidence, and notes.

skills.name: Media-to-Knowledge-Graph Extractor
skills.description: Create entities, events, relations, attributes, and temporal links from mixed media with provenance on every edge.

skills.name: Incident Narrative Builder
skills.description: Assemble a neutral chronological narrative from multiple cameras, recordings, logs, and statements while preserving conflicts.

skills.name: Lesson and Tutorial Converter
skills.description: Turn lectures or demonstrations into outlines, study notes, concepts, examples, questions, and practice tasks.

skills.name: Creative Review Digest
skills.description: Summarize stakeholder feedback by scene, asset, issue, priority, owner, and status, merging duplicates without losing dissent.

skills.name: Media Dataset Card Author
skills.description: Document dataset purpose, sources, composition, labels, consent, limitations, risks, splits, and intended or prohibited uses.

skills.name: Multi-Camera Synchronizer
skills.description: Align camera feeds through timecode, audio correlation, flashes, motion events, or manual anchors and report residual error.

skills.name: Audio-Video Sensor Fusion
skills.description: Join microphones, video, subtitles, telemetry, and event logs into a shared timeline with explicit clock assumptions.

skills.name: Transcript-to-Video Aligner
skills.description: Align words and speaker turns to precise video moments, even when transcripts contain omissions, paraphrases, or drift.

skills.name: External Log Correlator
skills.description: Relate media events to system logs, GPS, chat, control signals, or annotations using time normalization and confidence windows.

skills.name: Cross-Device Clock Drift Corrector
skills.description: Estimate offset and drift among devices, apply piecewise correction, and preserve original timestamps for audit.

skills.name: Duplicate Capture Resolver
skills.description: Detect overlapping recordings and determine which source offers the clearest visual, audio, metadata, or continuity evidence.

skills.name: Panoramic and Multi-View Scene Fusion
skills.description: Combine overlapping views into a broader spatial understanding while tracking parallax, blind spots, and calibration quality.

skills.name: Sensor Confidence Reconciler
skills.description: Resolve disagreement among modalities by data quality, calibration, coverage, and context rather than naive voting.

skills.name: Media and Document Case Binder
skills.description: Link recordings, images, transcripts, forms, emails, and notes into a navigable evidence package.

skills.name: Cross-Modal Consistency Checker
skills.description: Detect contradictions among spoken claims, visible actions, captions, metadata, and external records, then surface them for review.

skills.name: Face and Identity Redaction Planner
skills.description: Detect faces, name tags, plates, screens, and identifiers; design persistent redaction through motion and occlusion.

skills.name: Voice Privacy Transformer
skills.description: Plan reversible or irreversible voice de-identification while maintaining intelligibility, timing, and speaker separation.

skills.name: Sensitive Text Redactor
skills.description: Locate personal, financial, educational, health, credential, or location information in frames, audio, transcripts, and metadata.

skills.name: Consent and Release Tracker
skills.description: Associate participants and assets with releases, usage scope, territory, duration, revocation, and unresolved consent status.

skills.name: Bystander Privacy Auditor
skills.description: Detect incidental people, private spaces, reflections, screens, conversations, and contextual identifiers before publication.

skills.name: Child-Safety Media Reviewer
skills.description: Apply heightened privacy, age-appropriate handling, escalation, and restricted- distribution rules to media involving minors.

skills.name: Sensitive Scene Classifier
skills.description: Flag potentially graphic, intimate, distressing, or confidential scenes for controlled review without generating sensational descriptions.

skills.name: Metadata Privacy Scrubber
skills.description: Remove or generalize GPS, device identifiers, creator names, edit histories, thumbnails, hidden tracks, and sidecar metadata.

skills.name: Privacy-Preserving Analytics
skills.description: Produce aggregate counts, trends, and quality metrics while minimizing retention of identifiable media or raw embeddings.

skills.name: Publication Risk Gate
skills.description: Check consent, rights, redaction persistence, sensitive context, audience, and distribution settings before release.

skills.name: Media Provenance Inspector
skills.description: Inspect metadata, edit history, hashes, signatures, content credentials, and source chain while distinguishing absence from proof of manipulation.

skills.name: Synthetic Media Indicator Analyzer
skills.description: Assess visual, audio, temporal, and metadata indicators of synthesis or manipulation and report calibrated uncertainty.

skills.name: Frame-Level Edit Detector
skills.description: Locate possible splices, inserted frames, local retouching, compositing, resampling, or inconsistent noise patterns for expert review.

skills.name: Audio Edit and Splice Detector
skills.description: Flag discontinuities in ambience, phase, spectral texture, reverberation, timing, and background noise that may indicate edits.

skills.name: Deepfake Risk Triage
skills.description: Combine face, lip-sync, voice, lighting, motion, and provenance signals to prioritize suspicious content without declaring certainty unsupported.

skills.name: Source Camera Consistency Analyzer
skills.description: Compare lens behavior, sensor noise, encoding, timestamps, and metadata consistency across alleged captures.

skills.name: Reverse Context Verifier
skills.description: Check whether authentic media is presented with the wrong date, place, event, sequence, crop, caption, or surrounding context.

skills.name: Watermark and Credential Reader
skills.description: Detect visible or embedded watermarks, fingerprints, signatures, and content credentials and explain their verification status.

skills.name: Forensic Evidence Preservation
skills.description: Create read-only copies, hashes, inventories, chain-of-custody records, and analysis derivatives without altering originals.

skills.name: Forensic Finding Reviewer
skills.description: Challenge conclusions for alternative explanations, tool limitations, compression effects, missing controls, and reproducibility.

skills.name: Workplace Hazard Observer
skills.description: Flag visible hazards such as blocked exits, missing guards, unstable loads, spills, or unsafe proximity for qualified review.

skills.name: PPE Presence Checker
skills.description: Detect task-specific protective equipment where visibility permits and report occlusion, ambiguity, and policy configuration.

skills.name: Vehicle and Road Event Analyzer
skills.description: Track lanes, signals, vehicles, pedestrians, near conflicts, and observable driving events from dashcam or roadside footage.

skills.name: Facility Perimeter Event Detector
skills.description: Identify entry, exit, loitering, abandoned objects, tailgating, or restricted-zone crossings under explicit policy.

skills.name: Emergency Timeline Reconstructor
skills.description: Fuse alarms, calls, video, radio, and logs to produce a time-normalized sequence for response review.

skills.name: Fire Smoke and Leak Visual Triage
skills.description: Detect visible smoke, flame, steam, spray, or pooling as an alerting aid, not a replacement for certified sensors.

skills.name: Crowd Flow and Congestion Analyzer
skills.description: Estimate movement direction, density, queues, bottlenecks, and egress constraints without identifying individuals.

skills.name: Equipment State Monitor
skills.description: Read indicator lights, gauges, displays, motion, sound, and operating cycles to flag abnormal observable states.

skills.name: Security Footage Review Assistant
skills.description: Search long recordings for configured events, return evidence clips, and preserve context before and after each event.

skills.name: Safety Alert Verification Gate
skills.description: Require corroborating cues, confidence thresholds, human escalation, and false-alarm tracking before consequential action.

skills.name: Scientific Imaging Assistant
skills.description: Inspect microscopy, telescope, thermal, multispectral, or laboratory imagery using domain calibration and explicit measurement limits.

skills.name: Medical Media Documentation Assistant
skills.description: Describe observable content in approved medical images or recordings for documentation support, never as autonomous diagnosis.

skills.name: Ultrasound and Imaging Quality Checker
skills.description: Assess acquisition quality, orientation labels, coverage, artifacts, and missing views for qualified clinical review.

skills.name: Laboratory Video Experiment Analyzer
skills.description: Track apparatus states, procedural steps, timing, visible reactions, anomalies, and deviations from a supplied protocol.

skills.name: Thermal Pattern Interpreter
skills.description: Analyze calibrated thermal imagery for relative heating, cooling, hotspots, and temporal change while checking emissivity and scale.

skills.name: Drone Survey Media Analyzer
skills.description: Inspect aerial imagery for coverage, overlap, blur, terrain, structures, change, and mapping suitability while respecting flight and privacy rules.

skills.name: Industrial Inspection Vision
skills.description: Detect visible corrosion, cracks, deformation, wear, leaks, missing parts, or contamination against reference criteria.

skills.name: Technical Diagram and Schematic Interpreter
skills.description: Read symbols, connections, annotations, flows, dimensions, and component relationships from engineering visuals.

skills.name: Screen-Based Instrument Reader
skills.description: Extract values, trends, alarms, and units from equipment displays while preserving timestamps and uncertainty.

skills.name: Research Observation Coder
skills.description: Apply a defined coding scheme to recorded behavior or experiments with inter-rater checks and traceable examples.

skills.name: Lecture Understanding Assistant
skills.description: Combine speech, slides, board work, demonstrations, and questions into structured notes and concept maps.

skills.name: Skill Demonstration Assessor
skills.description: Compare a recorded procedure with a supplied rubric, locating completed, missed, out- of-order, or unsafe steps.

skills.name: Language Pronunciation Coach
skills.description: Analyze segmental pronunciation, stress, rhythm, pacing, and intelligibility with actionable practice examples.

skills.name: Music Lesson Feedback Assistant
skills.description: Review practice recordings for rhythm, pitch, tone, articulation, posture cues, and progress against assigned goals.

skills.name: Sports Technique Coach
skills.description: Break movement into phases, compare with a defined technique model, and provide safe, non-medical improvement cues.

skills.name: Presentation Rehearsal Coach
